Title: Generally Available – New Azure Event Grid events for Azure API Management Self-hosted gateway

Body.Content:
We are announcing the support for 11 new Azure Event Grid event types in Azure API Management. These events are all related to the management, deployment, and networking configuration of the self-hosted gateway in Azure API Management.  

With these new events, customers can be notified for the following scenarios: 

  • Self-hosted gateway creation, update, and deletion. 
  • APIs added and removed from the self-hosted gateway. 
  • Certificate authority creation, update, and deletion from the self-hosted gateway. 
  • Hostname configuration creation, update, and deletion from the self-hosted gateway. 

Click here to learn more.
